create_interface_config: create an InterfaceConfig object with a slab, adsorbates, solvent, and ions for molecular simulation
create_interface_on_sites: build solvent and ion interface configurations on top of existing adsorbate-slab atoms objects
create_packmol_atoms: pack solvent molecules and ions into a unit cell volume using packmol geometry constraints
run_packmol: run the packmol executable with an input file to generate packed molecular structures
randomize_coords: randomly reposition atoms within their unit cell using weighted fractional coordinates
